summary: P1.3 Iteration 2 - Runtime Ops Testing Complete. All 24 tests passed. Live PnL engine, runtime alert triggers, daily smoke script, exchange adapter guards, and admin dashboard runtime cards all working correctly.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing admin user and test data
context_for_next_testing_agent: P1.3 Iteration 2 features fully tested and working. All runtime endpoints (pnl/summary, pnl/positions, alerts, health/smoke), exchange adapter guards, daily smoke script, and admin dashboard runtime cards are operational.

GET /api/runtime/pnl/summary.details: Returns admin aggregate with scope=admin_all, realized_pnl, unrealized_pnl, net_pnl, by_symbol, by_user, open_positions, fees, funding, updated_at

GET /api/runtime/pnl/positions.details: Returns position rows with user_id, symbol, position_qty, avg_entry_price, mark_price, realized_pnl, unrealized_pnl, fees, funding, net_pnl, updated_at

GET /api/runtime/alerts.details: Returns runtime_* prefixed alerts with correct payload contract (severity, source, threshold, actual_value, timestamp, user_id?, symbol?)

GET /api/runtime/health/smoke.details: Returns last smoke result with run_status, summary, steps, trigger_source, started_at, completed_at

Alert payload contract.details: All alerts contain severity, source, threshold, actual_value, timestamp. user_id and symbol are optional.

Daily smoke SKIPPED_CREDENTIAL_MISSING.details: When DAILY_SMOKE_TARGET_USER_EMAIL is missing, ingest step returns SKIPPED_CREDENTIAL_MISSING, overall status is DEGRADED, and alert is generated

Exchange adapter guard - LIVE_TRADING_EN.details: LIVE_TRADING_ENABLED=false is default, live mode requires both EXECUTION_MODE=live AND LIVE_TRADING_ENABLED=true

Exchange adapter guard - TESTNET_TRADING.details: TESTNET_TRADING_ENABLED=false is default, testnet mode requires both EXECUTION_MODE=testnet AND TESTNET_TRADING_ENABLED=true

Binance adapter guard blocking.details: BinanceExecutionAdapter raises RuntimeError('live_guard_blocked') or RuntimeError('testnet_guard_blocked') when guards not enabled

Admin dashboard runtime cards.details: Admin dashboard displays Canlı PnL Özeti (scope, open_positions, realized, unrealized, net), Son Runtime Alertler (runtime_* alerts with severity), Son Smoke Sonucu (status, summary, completed_at)

mocked_apis_list: SIM adapter is default (no real exchange calls)
